subject: Sola Engage onboarding — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor details
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Morgan <lucas@sola-engage.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sola Engage — onboarding docs to activate vendor/PO

Hi Lucas,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — we want to get Sola Engage set up in our vendor portal ASAP so payments and contract terms flow cleanly. To complete procurement activation we need:

- Signed DPA (we accept DocuSign or a scanned PDF)
- Link to your latest SOC 2 report (or AICPA letter) or SOC 2 Type II PDF
- Current subprocessor list (name, function, country)
- Billing contact + PO instructions (preferred PO format, remit-to email)
- Vendor intake form (attached) filled out and returned

Can you return these by EOD Monday 4/12? I’ve CC'd Mina (your Redwood account owner) and Rishi from Legal in case of any DPA items that need discussion.

Appreciate it — next step after docs are received is Finance creating a PO and Legal signing the DPA.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_intake_form_redwood_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

----
From: Lucas Morgan <lucas@sola-engage.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sola-engage.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 10:02:14 -0400
Subject: Re: Sola Engage — onboarding docs to activate vendor/PO

Diego / Mina,

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick update from our side: we attached a signed copy of the DPA (PDF) to this reply and we host an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report at the link below. For subprocessors we have a current export I can share by Monday — most of our subprocessors are cloud infra and analytics vendors.

DPA: Sola_DPA_signed.pdf (attached)
SOC 2 link: https://sola-share.example.com/reports/sola-soc2-2026-type2 (also pasted below)

PO/Billing: Our billing team uses PO numbers in the format SOLA-PO-YYYY-##### and invoices should go to ap@sola-engage.com. Let me know if you need a remit address.

DocuSign link (if you prefer to sign online): https://app.docusign.com/sola/ds12345

Thanks,
Lucas Morgan
Head of Partnerships, Sola Engage
Vendor attachments: Sola_DPA_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Morgan <lucas@sola-engage.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 09:43:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Sola Engage — onboarding docs to activate vendor/PO

Lucas,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of legal follow-ups on the DPA:

- Thank you for the signed PDF. We need to confirm whether you agree to Redwood's standard subprocessor notification clause (Section 9). If you expect any negotiated redlines, please share them inline or via a marked-up document.
- I’ve attached our DPA_redline_template.docx — if you can mark changes there, that will speed review.
- Please provide the subprocessor export with the following fields: name, service provided, location (country/region), and whether the subprocessor processes Redwood customer data.

If you are unable to accept Section 9 as-is, highlight the exact language you propose. We try to keep DPA redlines minimal for mid-market vendors but will review any specific requests.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA_redline_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

----
From: Lucas Morgan <lucas@sola-engage.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@sola-engage.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:20:05 -0400
Subject: Re: Sola Engage — onboarding docs to activate vendor/PO

Rishi / Mina / Diego,

Per Rishi's request, attached is an export of our subprocessor inventory (Sola_subprocessors_20270412.csv). We do not currently use any subprocessors that process Redwood customer content on our behalf; most subprocessors handle telemetry, analytics, and identity services.

We reviewed Section 9 and do not have any substantive redlines at this time — small editorial tweak proposed in the attached CSV notes column. If legal needs anything more formal we can provide a tracked-change DPA, but we hope the signed PDF is fine.

For PO creation: our AP team prefers the PO be issued to:
Sola Engage, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Payable
ap@sola-engage.com
Remit: 123 Commerce Ave, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105

Attachments: Sola_subprocessors_20270412.csv (text/csv)
SOC 2 report: https://sola-share.example.com/reports/sola-soc2-2026-type2

Let us know if you need the subprocessor CSV in a different format.

Best,
Lucas

----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:37:48 -0700
Subject: Summary: Sola Engage onboarding docs received — request to create PO

Diego / Evelyn — quick summary from the thread for Finance/PO creation. I’m forwarding the vendor's artifacts and next steps below:

Received from Sola Engage:
- Signed DPA (Sola_DPA_signed.pdf) — vendor accepts Section 9 with minor editorial notes (see Rishi's comment).
- SOC 2 Type II report (hosted link) — accessible at: https://sola-share.example.com/reports/sola-soc2-2026-type2
- Subprocessor inventory (Sola_subprocessors_20270412.csv) — no subprocessors processing customer content; mostly telemetry and analytics vendors.
- Vendor billing info and remit address as provided in Lucas' message.

Request for Finance: please create a vendor record and issue a PO using format SOLA-PO-2027-#####. Use the remit address below and set default payment terms NET45 unless AP requests otherwise. Allocate to cost center: PLATFORM_SERVICES / Project: CUSTOMER_ONBOARDING.

Rishi — let me know if legal wants the vendor to return a tracked-change DPA. If not, we can proceed to finalize.

Thanks — Mina Haddad
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments forwarded: Sola_DPA_signed.pdf; Sola_subprocessors_20270412.csv; link to SOC2 report
